prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished 16:9 full-screen HEXBLADE combat HUD concept, variant A: COMIC CUTOUT FLOATING.
Input image 1 is the original combat-screen UI design reference and background edit target. Preserve its isometric industrial arena, central olive chibi mech fighting cream insect robots with a red saber arc, blue cleaning drone, floor blocks, smoke, camera, composition, cel-rendered game art. Do not introduce or redesign characters. Change the HUD only.

Primary request: develop the reference's cream/lime comic-book graphic language into a truly panel-free floating HUD. REMOVE EVERY large dark navy backing plate and enclosing cream panel frame at all four corners and top center. No HUD widget may have a filled rectangle, polygon, circle or opaque/semitransparent background behind it. Actual gameplay must remain visible between all HUD strokes/icons/text. Do not merely reduce panel opacity. Text readability uses tight individual ink outlines and small cast shadows ONLY, never a shared plaque. Keep cream bold condensed italic lettering, mint green HP, orange boost, lime stipple accents limited to tiny detached marks, crisp black ink outline on individual illustrated icons.

Layout: upper left a standalone cropped mech-head icon, directly adjacent five disconnected slanted mint health segments and '5/5', small orange boost segments below. 'HEXBLADE' is floating text. Upper middle floating 'ROOM 0/9' with a tiny isolated divider and 'ENEMIES 2' in coral, no surrounding frame. Upper right a bare floating node-and-path minimap directly over gameplay, no square border or map background; tiny dark outline around colored paths ensures contrast; 'SCORE 100' below.
Lower left a standalone blue three-eye drone cutout, floating 'TRIAD' / 'SUPPORT', open thin mint support-meter line and '0/100', below loose 'Q DOCK', 'X SHIELD', 'Z CLEAN' text with bold green letters; NO keycap boxes, NO support panel.
Lower right six individual illustrated ability icons floating directly over floor in a compact loose cluster: saber LMB, gun RMB 17/30, dash SPACE, jets SHIFT, canister L+R, rocket R, and small E interaction mark if space permits. Remove all black disks, enclosing circular icon borders, rectangular keycaps. Separate with whitespace, emphasize saber size. Small cream italic binding labels outlined per letter are allowed.
Style: strong comic cutouts, chunky crisp silhouette, playful high energy, professional usable action-game HUD. Broad clear center for combat, compact edge HUD. One concept image only, no split screen, no sample board, no title banner, no annotations, no watermark.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished 16:9 full-screen HEXBLADE combat HUD concept, variant B: OPEN-LINE TECHNICAL FLOATING.
Input image 1 is the original combat UI style reference and background edit target. Preserve the isometric industrial arena, central olive chibi mech fighting cream insect robots with red saber arc, blue cleaning drone, floor blocks, smoke, camera and composition, cel-rendered game art. No new characters. Only redesign the HUD.
Primary request: keep the cream/mint/lime/orange comic-sci-fi visual identity, but produce a distinctly lighter, more precise, more spacious floating interface. Remove ALL reference navy panels, thick enclosing cream frames, action-icon disks and keycap boxes. Do not add any filled background, gradient plaque, translucent glass, circular backing or enclosing polygon behind any widget. Floor and walls must be visible around and between all marks. Contrast through thin ink outline on individual text/icons, not shared backgrounds.
Style: delicate cream and mint open-line instrumentation, short ticks, separated slim slanted gauge strokes, large readable condensed italic numerals, restraint. NOT excessive glowing holograms, no blur. Retain a few small illustrated 3D cel icons; mech portrait and drone portrait much smaller than reference to reduce screen occupancy.

Upper left: compact tiny standalone mech-head silhouette, floating 'HEXBLADE' small above five thin separate mint HP segments and readable '5/5'. Orange boost three fine segments below. Add two short disconnected cream alignment ticks, never full corners/frame.
Upper center: slim floating 'ROOM 0/9' and coral 'ENEMIES 2' with whitespace; modest type, no plate.
Upper right: a small borderless mini-map of cream/mint outlined nodes and pink/blue current rooms; floor is visible underneath. Fine connection lines. 'SCORE' small and '100' bigger below.
Lower left: small three-eye drone icon, floating 'TRIAD', mint 'SUPPORT', a thin mint progress baseline with two end ticks, '0/100', and quiet single line 'Q DOCK   X SHIELD   Z CLEAN', no boxes.
Lower right: orderly straight floating two-row grid of six small independent illustrated actions, minimal individual cream captions: SHIFT jets, L+R green canister, R rocket above; SPACE dash boots, RMB orange gun with '17/30', LMB red saber below. Uniform spacing, no enclosing shape or filled button. A bare tiny 'E' down-arrow placed to the left.
Hierarchy: health and ammo clear at a glance, all peripheral HUD neatly aligned in safe margins, broad central combat view. This should visibly differ from chunky comic cutout by smaller silhouettes, fine lines, calm spacing and typography precision, while still belonging to the same game. ONE concept image, no board, no title, no annotations, no watermark.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished 16:9 full-screen HEXBLADE combat HUD concept, variant C: DIAGONAL ARCADE FLOATING.
Input image 1 is the original combat-screen style reference and background edit target. Preserve the exact isometric industrial arena, olive chibi mech attacking cream insect robots with a red saber, blue cleaning drone, smoke, floor blocks, camera and central gameplay composition. No new characters or background redesign. Only develop the UI.
Primary request: a polished energetic arcade HUD in the same cream/mint/lime/orange comic style, every HUD element floating directly on gameplay WITHOUT ANY backplates. Remove original thick cream panel frames and solid navy panels. No black rectangles, no filled polygons, no translucent glass plates, no circular icon backgrounds, no filled keycaps, no darkened corner gradients. Thin individual ink outlines and short shadows under letters/icons are permitted. The design is meaningfully different from a standard box-based HUD.

Direction: asymmetrical diagonal rhythm, oversized expressive italic numerals, standalone illustrated cutouts, sparse disconnected slash accents, just a few lime halftone flecks. Use visual hierarchy and open composition rather than frames.

Top left: compact floating olive mech head beside an oversized cream '5/5'. Under numeral EXACTLY FIVE distinct disconnected mint slanted HP bars, all five clearly countable. A small 'HEXBLADE' label above and orange BOOST three staggered segments below. Maximum area narrower than reference panel.
Top middle: dramatically readable '0/9' with tiny 'ROOM', spaced apart from coral '2' with tiny 'ENEMIES', both on open background. A pair of tiny diagonal mint marks, no enclosure.
Top right: bare floating mini-map nodes and paths above small 'SCORE' and bold '100', no map frame or backdrop.
Bottom left: standalone blue three-eye drone portrait, prominent '0/100' with smaller 'TRIAD SUPPORT'; slim mint progress slash/line below. 'Q DOCK', 'X SHIELD', 'Z CLEAN' are loose text aligned on a subtle diagonal rising toward the right; no boxes.
Bottom right: ability icons arranged in an OPEN QUARTER-FAN around a large standalone red saber in the corner. Saber is the main action with 'LMB'; small orange gun 'RMB' and '17/30' just left; blue dash boots 'SPACE' farther left; blue jets 'SHIFT', green canister 'L+R', rocket 'R' climb along the right edge. Only TWO short disconnected cream curved strokes suggest the quarter-fan rhythm; NO closed rings, NO disks, NO connected enclosing silhouette. Keep labels horizontal and readable, do not rotate them into the arc. Tiny mint E down-arrow to cluster's left.
Keep HUD out of the central action. Strong premium comic arcade feel, bold but efficient use of space, lively edges rather than excessive VFX. All required labels accurate, no extra UI copy, no title banner, no multi-panel board, no watermark.

Preserve ALL other pixels/composition/layout, floating icons, fine-line HUD, cream typography, background, characters, lighting and minimap. Do not add backplates, panels, boxes, circles or more decoration. Do not generate new characters. Return the complete same wide image with only this local health-segment count correction.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target: a finished floating HEXBLADE combat HUD arcade mockup. Refine ONLY the HUD while preserving the exact background, characters, camera, combat action and all game-world pixels. Remove the green rectangular keycap backgrounds and their dark rectangular silhouettes around Q, X and Z at lower left: leave standalone mint 'Q', 'X', 'Z' letters with tight per-letter ink outlines followed by cream DOCK, SHIELD, CLEAN. No box of any sort. Reduce the large upper-center 0/9 and ENEMIES 2 group by about 20 percent while keeping centered placement, and reduce SCORE 100 by about 15 percent. Reduce lime speckle decoration quantity at all HUD corners by half to simplify. Preserve the other arcade brush lettering, FIVE mint HP segments with 5/5, standalone mech/drone cutouts, support gauge, right open fan of icons and all labels. Keep every widget directly floating over gameplay; absolutely no opaque/translucent plates, enclosing frames, button disks or keycaps anywhere. Do not redraw characters, add new content, change the scene, or add a title. Return ONE complete same wide image.
